out.answer: As of July 15, 2026, the total outstanding borrowings of the company and its subsidiaries on a consolidated basis aggregated to ₹ 2,745.67 million.
out.quote:
As of July 15, 2026, the outstanding borrowings of our Company and our Subsidiaries (on a consolidated basis) aggregated to 
₹ 2,745.67 million (including non-fund based borrowings of ₹ 212.46 million).
